title: carthamus atractyloides
intro: Carthamus atractyloides, commonly known as Safflower, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carthamus atractyloides include wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
